_doc: The laborer with his hammer raised (the human chose it: S07, S29). He never moves, so the raised pose is baked into a new ink piece by scripts/laborer_raise.py, from the rest-pose piece (assets/engravings/ink/laborer.png, kept). Cuts are traced over the ink on a grid, in piece pixels, as in config/puppets.json; angles are degrees counter-clockwise on the page. The forearm (and fist) turns at the elbow; the hammer then turns at the fist, so its head ends up above the hand. search = the fill's search radius in px (tighter than the puppets' 280, so the shirt fills from the shirt).
